_meta.purpose: Perpetual fallback directives for sentinel_directive_generator when LLM suggestions all dedupe. Ensures builder queue is NEVER empty per directives_never_empty convention.
changelog: 1.2.0 (2026-05-02): renamed top-level 'standing_goals' -> 'goals', renamed per-entry 'task_name' -> 'task' and 'goal' -> 'description', added required 'handler' field. Schema now matches standing_goals_fallback.py REQUIRED_FIELDS contract. Previous shape silently produced 0 emissions every cycle.

goals.description: Build a PyPI discovery paginator daemon as a third discovery source beyond npm + github. Search PyPI JSON API for keywords mcp-server, model-context-protocol, mcp-tools. Paginate 5 pages of 100 per 600s cycle. Insert candidates into mcp_discovery_candidates via WriteService ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING. server_id = blake2s('pypi:' + name).hexdigest()[:16]. Logs FileHandler only. ISO 8601 timestamps. Rate limit 60 calls/min.

Build a daemon that runs every 1800s and updates mcp_server_registry.verdict by aggregating mcp_signal_scores across the 7 trust framework signals using the documented weights. Pure read of signal_scores, single UPDATE statement to registry per row. Uses ws_write for the UPDATE. Skips rows where verdict was UPDATEd in the last 6 hours. Emits a verdict_aggregation mesh_event per cycle with counts. This is the verdict_assigner carryover from PROJECT_GOALS.md, distinct from the archived decision_emitter.

Build mcp_registry_ingestor_v2 that reads BOTH remotes[] and packages[] from registry entries (current ingestor only reads packages[], leaving raw_packages='[]' for HTTPS-served MCPs). Populates mcp_registry_facts with proper transport classification (stdio for packages, http/sse/ws for remotes). Idempotent re-run via ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING. After this lands and re-runs, signal_bridge will have real transport info as a backup data source for Signals 1 and 4.

Build a RunPod session monitor daemon that polls RunPod API every 300s for active pod status. Writes pod IP, port, GPU type, status, credit_balance to /home/workspace/shared/outputs/runpod_active.json (UTF-8 BOM-free for tower interop). Emits mesh_event with severity=ERROR if pod terminates unexpectedly or credit_balance < 5. Reads RUNPOD_API_KEY from env. Exits gracefully if no active pods. This supports the SFT training program where adapters are trained on RunPod.

Build an adapter loader service that integrates the trained ZoMesh LoRA adapter (Qwen2.5-3B + student_v1 from rob531/zomesh-sentinel-sft GitHub adapters/student-v1) into the inference router as a mesh_specialist tier. Loads adapter at startup with peft.PeftModel.from_pretrained. Exposes /generate POST endpoint on port 8793 (FastAPI + uvicorn). Routes task_type=sentinel_assess to the adapter; falls back to MiniMax if adapter inference exceeds 10s or errors. Logs adapter latency per request to mesh_memory.

Build a signal-quality monitor daemon that runs every 1800s and computes the distinct-value count for each of the 7 trust framework signals across mcp_signal_scores. Emits a mesh_event severity=WARNING when any signal has < 5 distinct values across the population (the 'bad signal = same signal' gate from PROJECT_GOALS.md defensibility section). Writes per-signal distinct counts to mesh_memory for trend visibility. Pure read; never modifies signal_scores.

Build the MCP project canonicalizer daemon (deferred April 21 work). Creates and maintains mcp_project_canonical and mcp_project_members tables. Groups MCPs by canonical project (npm package, github repo, pypi package) so a single project's npm publish + github source + pypi mirror are recognized as one canonical project, not three independent MCPs. Unlocks UI aggregation and supply-chain-fork visibility. Idempotent re-run.
constraints: Schema additions only - never alter existing tables
